figures.caption: Table 1: Results for MBC generation using LLMs. Metrics are reported for MBCs generated both without and with information retrieval (IR) using MEDIAREF, along with the average token count of generated MBCs (#Tokens) per model. For error rate, lower values are better; for all other metrics, higher values are better. Best scores are shown in blue, and second-best scores in light blue. Overall, MBCs generated with IR outperform those without IR across all metrics except error rate, where performance remains similar or degrades slightly.
Figure 1: An example media background check (MBC) for the Rebel News outlet, adapted from Media Bias/Fact Check. The full text is available at https://mediabiasfactcheck.com/the-rebel/.

Figure 3: Qualitative analysis results for Clarity, Relevance, Informativeness, and Verifiability. Colours encode score magnitude (low → high, i.e., 0 → 3), consistently across all models. Note that the maximum Clarity score is 2, and the values shown are the average scores assigned by our two expert annotators.

Figure 2: MBC generation method for a given news source using external information. An LLM generates an initial background check for the news source and updates it by incorporating the supporting evidence found.
Table 2: Queries used to retrieve evidence from MEDIAREF, with corresponding questions used to extract answers with DeBERTa. Reproduced from Schlichtkrull (2024).
Figure 4: Spearman correlations between MBC clarity, relevance, informativeness, and verifiability scores.
Figure 5: Prompt used to generate MBCs without external evidence. [Source name] stands for the name of the target news source.

Figure 6: Prompt used to update MBCs when provided with external evidence. [Source name] stands for the name of the target news source. [New information] represents the retrieved information to be incorporated.

Figure 7: Prompt used to determine whether an atomic fact is entailed or contradicted by a generated MBC. [question] is replaced with the atomic fact template, and [text] is replaced by the generated MBC.
